test.name: Autonomous mode flag triggers research
test.description: The --autonomous flag is an explicit trigger in the skill description. The user wants unattended GPS research without pausing for clarifying questions.
test.xfail_reason: The model intermittently fails to spawn gps-mentor for --autonomous prompts. The mentor-gate validator (test_mentor_gate_spawned) catches this ground-truth gap (issue #2686). Remove when the research skill consistently spawns gps-mentor under autonomous mode.

judge_context: --autonomous is a listed trigger for the research orchestrator
Should proceed without pausing for clarifying questions
